kens-rc3.version: KENS 1.4 RC3 Win32, primary SourceForge distribution
kens-rc3.lineage: Original 2002-2004 KENS; predates the flamewing rewrite; separate algorithm implementation, not an assumed oracle
kens-rc3.build: Original 32-bit DLLs; tests/support/original_kens.cs compiled with .NET Framework csc 4.8, /platform:x86

kens15.version: Archive kens-1.4.22.tar.xz; extracted directory kens-1.5a1; CMake project kens_1.4.22
kens15.license: LGPL-3.0-or-later rewritten codecs; LGPL-2.1-or-later retained Saxman; GPL tools (see archive)
kens15.lineage: ChangeLog.htm explicitly replaces Kosinski, Enigma and Nemesis with flamewing routines. Those codecs share mdcomp ancestry; Saxman is retained original code.
kens15.build: GCC 16.2, C++98, CMake policy minimum 3.5; tests/references/kens15-portability.patch applied

kenssharp.lineage: Based on an earlier flamewing/mdcomp implementation; inherited and independently fixed bugs are possible; shared-lineage check
kenssharp.build: VS 2022 MSBuild, Release AnyCPU, .NET Framework v4.8, empty TargetFrameworkProfile; generated EXE config switched from runtime v2 to v4; no codec source changes

snkrle.license: No license specified in repository; source and binaries not vendored
snkrle.lineage: kirjavascript / snkenjoi original C codec reference; decomp.asm not executed in this checkpoint
snkrle.adaptation: BE16 tile-count header multiplied/divided by 32 for cross-decodes; token body unchanged

kens-mirror.lineage: Supplementary mirror DLLs rebuilt in 2015; hashes differ from the primary 2004 RC3 distribution. Not used for committed fixtures.

accurate-kosinski.build: Unmodified codec source; GCC 16.2, CMake/Ninja, C90; ClownLZSS frontend/header codecs use C++20
accurate-kosinski.lineage: Reimplementation intended to reproduce Sega compressor output, including historical match-selection quirks; not the released original LZEXE source.

clownlzss.build: Unmodified codec source; GCC 16.2, CMake/Ninja, C90; ClownLZSS frontend/header codecs use C++20
clownlzss.lineage: Separate implementation informed by mdcomp optimal-parsing design; current pinned frontend and codec headers are C++20, compression core is C90.

clownnemesis.build: Unmodified codec source; GCC 16.2, CMake/Ninja, C90; ClownLZSS frontend/header codecs use C++20
clownnemesis.lineage: Separate Nemesis implementation; tested both improved and Sega-accurate modes.

original-saxman.license: Haruhiko Okumura permissive use/distribute/modify grant in LZSS.c; see source for modifications/attribution
original-saxman.lineage: Okumura 1989 LZSS with Clownacy Saxman zero-history modifications. Upstream describes Sega-output reproduction; not a recovered Sega-specific source release. Ring-copy behavior differs from documented Sega zero-fill for origin-crossing matches.
original-saxman.adapter: tests/support/original_saxman.c supplies LE16 compressed-body length and bounds decode reads; codec body unchanged
